ev_0114.reviewer_note: Legit: a new number, but a shared event yesterday, a tiny amount, the friend's own name, no urgency.

messages.text: Hi Meena, Priya from yoga here! I lost my phone on the MRT so this is my new number.
Oh no! Saw you at class this morning, you didn't mention haha.

Happened on the way home 😩 Anyway, the two gala dinner tickets for the animal shelter fundraiser came through, S$90 each. Could you pay me back today? I'm topping up my new SIM and want to clear things.
Sure, will see you Thursday anyway. Same name?
Yup, Priya Raman, Kampong Federal Bank 381-560927-418. Thanks babe!

ev_0127.customer_answer: Paying my yoga friend Priya back for the gala dinner tickets she bought for us.
ev_0127.reviewer_note: Legit (subtle): a new number and 'pay me back today', but they met that morning, the tickets were agreed before, and it's the friend's own name. (The hardest negative in this group.)
